IFRC reported response work still under way as of 11 October 2026, with holding centres in Bidur and Rasuwa in use. No reports found after 11 October 2026.

ifrc-flood-appeal-mdrgh023.summary: Heavy rains and flooding hit parts of Ghana in late June and early July 2026, including the capital Accra. The IFRC reported 34 deaths and about 89,000 people affected in an update dated 7 August 2026. The Red Cross launched a six-month response to support 30,000 people, and that operation is ongoing.

ifrc-landslide-8111.summary: Heavy rain from 27-29 September 2026 triggered flash floods and landslides in Dawei and Launglon townships, Tanintharyi Region, Myanmar. Floodwaters had receded by early October, but rescue and relief work continues and further landslides remain possible. Reports give 41 deaths and 20 missing in Launglon. Sources date the event to late September, not the 8 October feed date.

usgs-earthquake-us7000q1.summary: A magnitude 5.7 to 5.9 earthquake struck near Khuzdar in Balochistan, Pakistan, on 17 October 2026 at 05:06 UTC. Residents left their homes and gathered in open spaces. Authorities reported no casualties or damage. Seismological centres continue tracking possible aftershocks.
